scope: Ongoing BCR vs baseline comparison; exact same-run full validation dumps at step580
categories: Disjoint categories compare each matched unit logged n_err/n_ref. Improved includes recovered; persistent means both bad and equal rate; worsening_persistent means both bad and higher rate. Rate comparisons preserve each run logged denominator, including any compound-dependent changes.
matching: dataset + stable id; grouped Earnings uses parent_audio_path, ordered segments; unchanged gts and segment identities required
count_policy: Only nonnull logged counts; Earnings contributes one group-head count per parent. No rescoring or null-to-zero replacement.
table_policy: Flatten actual run files by columns; deduplicate identical cumulative observations, preserve source row/slot; enrich by exact input/output/gts and numeric score within rel/abs 1e-6 (table scores cast to float32)

limitations: Identical raw gts do not guarantee equal logged n_ref: the actual merge_compounds scorer can normalize ref/hyp jointly. Any observed denominator differences are listed per dataset; retain each run original counts rather than assuming a fixed denominator.
W&B selected tables are cross-dataset low-score subsets and cannot estimate corpus failure rates.
Counts use each exact run scorer output; text changes alone do not establish acoustic or causal mechanisms.
No datasets are pooled or cross-dataset averaged.
cache_policy: Reuse complete hash-verified dumps only for the same selected validation lineage and numeric p_err observation. Changed/repeated-step observations use distinct retained lineage directories; collector path/timestamp and W&B-versus-exact transport do not invalidate an otherwise identical observation. Explicit refreshes preserve old paths. Missing uploads remain gaps and may be retried.

observation_binding.identity_policy: Run, validation step, resolved segment/submission/driver/source/config and per-dataset p_err; collector paths, collector timestamps and W&B-versus-exact transport are nonidentity evidence. Scalar tolerance 1e-10.
